name: Biohacker
text: Scientists who weaponize biology, injecting foes with inhibitors and boosting allies with serums. Biohackers blend battlefield medicine with tactical chemistry to control the flow of combat.

name: Envoy
text: Plucky leaders who support allies with battlefield directives, social savviness, and a suite of skills. Envoys call out directives to allies and are always full of sassy quips with useful tricks up their sleeves.

name: Evolutionist
text: Warriors who channel evolutionary energies to adapt their bodies to any threat. Evolutionists gain niche adaptations that grow more powerful as they level, turning themselves into living weapons.

name: Mechanic
text: A versatile martial class that commands a neural network called an exocortex — controlling a robot companion (drone), a deployable turret, or remote mines — and modifies tech gear on the fly. (Starfinder 2e playtest content.)

name: Mystic
text: Spellcasters with a connection to a divine, occult, or primal aspect of the universe. A mystic casts powerful spells and heals allies using a vitality network that acts as a floating pool of Hit Points.

name: Nanocyte
text: Living hosts to vast clouds of nanobots that can form weapons, armor, and tools on demand. Nanocytes direct their swarm to reshape the battlefield and their own body in real time.

name: Operative
text: Stealthy and highly skilled specialists who use guile and precise strikes to overcome enemies and obstacles. Operatives are the galaxy's premier spies, assassins, and scouts.

name: Precog
text: Temporal spellcasters who manipulate time through paradox-fueled abilities. Precogs see possible futures, accelerate or slow time for themselves and others, and rewrite recent events with their anachronistic power.

name: Solarian
text: Warriors who channel the power of stars and black holes, manifesting a solar weapon or solar armor. Solarians build attunement through stellar revelations and unleash zenith powers when fully attuned.

name: Soldier
text: Masters of combat who excel at dealing and absorbing damage. Soldiers choose a fighting style and gain gear boosts that define their approach to battle.

name: Technomancer
text: Spellcasters who blend magic with technology, bending the laws of physics with their unique spells. Technomancers can hack and interface with machines through magic, blurring the line between the arcane and the digital.

name: Vanguard
text: Durable frontline fighters who manipulate entropy — the decay of all things — to destroy foes and protect allies. Vanguards accumulate entropic charges and unleash devastating abilities fueled by the fundamental force of dissolution.

name: Witchwarper
text: Reality-bending spellcasters altered by a paradoxical event. Witchwarpers explore infinite possibilities of the multiverse, creating quantum fields that subvert space and time and casting powerful magic.
